coordinate_system.world_axes: x east, y north, z up; same world frame as self.x/y/z
coordinate_system.s: horizontal arc length from start/finish, increasing in direction of travel; wrap at length_m
coordinate_system.bank: positive when right edge is higher
coordinate_system.grade_dz_ds: geometric dz/ds; NOT the filtered preview.rows grade (sin of slope)
coordinate_system.elevation: asset elevation datum, not a height above the road
coordinate_system.rendering: top-down x right, y up; do not swap the replay world axes

boundaries.meaning: geometric road edge and kerb outlines, not vehicle-centre penalty/collision thresholds
